title: Irish Hash Browns
description: Crispy and delicious hash browns made with irish potatoes, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Soak the grated potatoes in cold water for 30 minutes to remove excess starch.
Drain the potatoes and squeeze out as much water as possible using a clean kitchen towel.
Heat the warm oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the grated potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use a spatula to shape the potatoes into a flat layer.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and add the hash (if using).
Use a spatula to gently fold the hash into the potatoes.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until crispy.
